contracts.action: Delegated-task question notifications now steer into the running parent turn (when the provider supports non-interrupting steering) instead of always queueing
contracts.equivalent_path: The delegatedCompletion (mailbox) steer route in the same block, Orchestrator.ts:5739-5775, which this change extends to command.notification?.source.kind === 'delegated_task'.
contracts.before_after: Before: only mailbox completions with completionWake 'always' were routed to steer_active; questions queued behind the running parent run. After: a delegated_task notification takes the same capability checks (live session, supportsActiveSteering, not activeSteeringInterruptsTools) and now also a stopReachedRun check, which is also new for the mailbox path. The notification validation at 5680-5695 runs before the mode switch, so the steer is not rejected. The steered message keeps the run's modelSelection and does not rewrite the thread selection (5837-5840, 4943-4944).
contracts.visible_effect: The parent agent sees the child's question mid-turn. The message is projected as a notification turn item on the running run (asserted in the new test, SteeringCompletion.integration.test.ts:701-707).
contracts.failure_mode: If the steer fails with turnCompleted, EffectWorker.ts:281-299 re-dispatches the same message id as queue_after_active and carries message.notification, so the notice starts a follow-up run. Before, it would have used start_immediately and been rejected by the notification validation at Orchestrator.ts:5680-5689. The reactor only cancels queued runs (DelegatedTaskQuestionReactor.ts:114-124), so a steered question that is answered later is not retracted. The message text already tells the agent to expect that ('If it is no longer pending, it was answered or dismissed').

summary:
I found no defects in this part. I read all four files in full and checked the changed paths against `DelegatedTaskQuestionReactor.ts`, the notification validation and the steer path.

The code does what the PR says. Delegated-task question notifications now steer into the running parent turn under the same capability checks as mailbox completions. The check also now includes `stopReachedRun`, which the mailbox route gains too. `EffectWorker.ts` re-queues a notification with `queue_after_active` and carries `notification` when the steer fails because the turn completed, so the notification validation no longer rejects it.

The doc's claim that only a *queued* notification is cancelled matches the reactor, which cancels only runs with status `queued`.

One behaviour to know about: when a steer falls back to a queued follow-up, a notification-only message runs with the thread's current model selection. A mailbox completion uses the original run's selection instead. The new test asserts the thread selection (`composerSelection`), so this looks deliberate.
